messages.title: From the Director's Desk
messages.summary: At the outset, I would like to thank and congratulate IIT Indore community and our esteemed recruiters for the contribution and support to the Institute. I commend the students for living up to the expectations of our recruiters, especially during the pandemic over the last two years. I firmly believe that the Institute has certainly carved a niche for itself and is poised to scale even greater heights in the near future. It is evident from the distinguished list of Overseas and Indian companies including PSUs who have showed trust in our students. The conducive academic and research environment of the Institute has ensured the behavioral development of inquisitiveness, innovativeness, and entrepreneurship amongst students. Through our experienced faculty, world-class facilities, and higher teaching standards, IIT Indore graduates are excelling socially, technically, and humanely.
messages.info: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore), established in 2009 as a second-generation IIT in Indore, India, is renowned for its excellence ineducation and research.Offering a diverse array ofprograms, the institution’s hallmark is its rigorous curriculum, which blends theory and practical and strongly emphasizes research and innovation. IIT Indore maintains a strong global presence, having established over 100 MoUs worldwide and securing more than 35 bilateral research grants with foreign institutes.IIT Indore has around 210 Faculty members, including experienced senior members from established IITs and young, vibrant scholars with global academic backgrounds, many of whom are listed among the top 2% of scientists in the world.Additionally, a mega project worth Rs 100 Cr under the DST National Mission on Cyber-Physical Systems is dedicated to developing cutting- edge technologies and training a skilled workforce in this domain.This project stands as a testament to IIT Indore’s commitment to fostering advancements in critical technological spheres. In alignment with the New Education Policy (NEP) objectives, IIT Indore has embraced a flexible approach to its BTech programs, welcoming qualified industry professionals and allowing flexibility in course selection and program duration.A joint MS degree program in Data Science and Management, conducted in collaboration with the Indian Institute of Management Indore, has garnered significant popularity.To further support entrepreneurial endeavors, the institute has registered the Section 8 Company Advanced Centre for Entrepreneurship (ACE) Foundation, which has incubated 52 startups till date.IIT Indore has actively fostered collaborations on national and international fronts through Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs).Notable partnerships include one with the Maker Bhavan Foundation and the Centre for Translational Research (CTR) which aims to modernize STEM education in Indian science and engineering by promoting a culture of making and active learning and nurturing talent. IIT Indore stands as a beacon of academic excellence, looking forward to collaborations with leading Indian and multinational companies, public sector organizations, financial institutions, and others.Our commitment to fostering partnerships and pushing the boundaries of knowledge ensures its position as a premier institution in India’s educational landscape.We place high importance on our relationship with the industry and are dedicated to making your time spent interviewing at IIT Indore fruitful and enjoyable.

messages.title: From the Professor-In-Charge, Career Advancement & Mentoring Centre
messages.summary: On behalf of IIT Indore, I take this opportunity to invite corporates, academia, and research organizations to interact with our vibrant students for Internships, Training, and conducting Campus Placements. The institute focuses on producing top-quality technocrats and scientists for the growth of our modern society and caters to the needs of corporates and institutions alike.
messages.info: On behalf of IIT Indore, I extend a cordial invitation to all corporates, academic institutions, and research organizations to engage with our vibrant students for internships, training, and campus placements. At IIT Indore, we prioritize holistic student development by providing a conducive learning environment that sets our students up for success in their chosen professions.Our dynamic curriculum empowers students to grasp and innovate across various technologies and conduct research that aligns with industry and societal needs.Beyond academics, our students actively participate in a wide range of technical, sporting, and literary activities throughout the year. Our institute boasts state-of-the-art research labs bolstered by national and international collaborations and funding that support our undergraduate and research students.Within a span of 15 years, IIT Indore is ranked 8th among all IITs in India (source: QS World Rankings 2024) and has established itself through the exceptional skills of our students and our commitment to rigorous research.We now seek to build enduring partnerships with companies through campus recruitment initiatives. I warmly invite your company to visit our campus and leverage this opportunity to discover some of the nation's brightest minds.We are committed to ensuring a seamless and mutually beneficial recruitment process for both the institute and our corporate partners.

about.intro: Established in 2009, the Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) is a prestigious institution in India, recognized for its excellence in engineering, science, and humanities education and research. Situated in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, IIT Indore boasts a robust global presence, having formed over 100 Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) and secured more than 35 bilateral research grants. The faculty comprises approximately 210 members, including esteemed scientists and emerging scholars. The institute has made significant contributions to research, with over 7,500 journal publications and 150 patents filed. Furthermore, IIT Indore is committed to providing a flexible, industry-responsive curriculum and fostering entrepreneurship through its Advanced Centre for Entrepreneurship. The institute celebrates its students' achievements on global platforms, notably at the Global Best M-GOV Awards 2023 and in various competitive programming contests. With a strong dedication to advancing knowledge and promoting collaborative efforts, IIT Indore offers a modern academic environment conducive to innovation and academic excellence.

about.faculty: The faculty at IIT Indore comprises experienced and distinguished professors, many of whom are recognized for their contributions to their respective fields. The faculty members are actively involved in research, publishing in reputed journals, and participating in international conferences.
about.student: Life at IIT Indore is vibrant and diverse, with numerous student clubs and organizations catering to a wide range of interests, including technical, cultural, and sports activities. Annual events like Fluxus (the cultural fest) and Concours (the tech fest) are highly anticipated, providing students with opportunities to showcase their talents and interact with peers from other institutions.
about.industry: IIT Indore maintains strong ties with the industry, facilitating internships, collaborative projects, and placements. The institute's placement cell works tirelessly to ensure that students have access to job opportunities in leading companies across various sectors. Graduates from IIT Indore have secured positions in top-tier firms globally, reflecting the institute's commitment to excellence in education and professional development.

departmentData.description: A 4-year UG program that offers graduates a strong foundation in Computer Science. Courses include: Mathematics, Discrete Mathematical Structures, Data Structures and Algorithms, Automata Theory and Logic, Software Engineering, Database and Information Systems, Parallel Computing, Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Computer Graphics and Visualization, Computational Intelligence, Computer Networks, Optimization Algorithms and Techniques, Compiler Techniques. B.Tech projects involve practical applications in various fields such as machine learning, computer vision, blockchain, natural language processing etc.

labels: M.Tech - Power Systems and Power Electronics
departmentData.description: A 4-year UG program that offers graduates a strong foundation in electrical engineering. Courses include: Analog Circuits, Digital Electronics, Electromagnetic Waves, VLSI Systems and Technology, Microprocessors and Digital Systems, Power Systems, Digital Signal Processing, MOS Devices and Modeling, System on Chip(SoC) Design, Information and Coding Theory. B.Tech projects involve microcontroller-based projects, designing and building electronic devices, and research in areas like renewable energy, power systems, wireless communication, and IC design.

Strengthening their command on analytical methods, simulation tools, and experimental techniques alike, students pursue projects involving a vast spectrum of industry relevant topics. B.Tech students work on innovative fuel needs, exhaust systems, and automotive sector challenges. M.Tech students specialize in Mechanical Systems Design, Thermal Energy Systems, Advanced Manufacturing, and Applied Optics and Laser Technology, collaborating with industries and research institutions like RRCAT, Indore. MS Research scholars focus on novel technologies in noise control, condition monitoring, digital twins, and Lab-on-a-chip for industrial and biomedical applications.

Civil Engineering at IIT Indore aims to play an active role in propelling India in its growth trajectory through innovative interdisciplinary research and educational programs at postgraduate levels. The M.Tech program offers specializations in Structural Engineering and Water, Climate and Sustainability, focusing on industry-oriented thesis work.

With 49 courses and 12 labs, students gain theoretical and practical expertise in materials engineering. The curriculum emphasizes practical learning with industry-connected projects in leading companies. B.Tech students focus on materials engineering fundamentals. M.Tech students specialize in Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science Engineering, participating in hands-on labs and industry projects.

labels: B.Tech. - Biomedical Engineering and Data Science
departmentData.description: The Department of Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering (BSBE) at IIT Indore aims to be a center of excellence in human resource development and research in Biosciences, Bioengineering, and Biomedical Engineering. Current projects include drug discovery for neurodegenerative diseases, nanoparticle-mediated drug delivery and disease theranostics, molecular immunology, cancer research, and musculoskeletal tissue engineering. Additional research focuses on algal biomass for aquatic feed, 2D and 3D cell culture systems, and neuro-robotics.

data.starter: Students of Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) often have several questions about the placement process, the internships, and the support provided by the Training and Placement (T&P) Cell. Here are some of the most frequently asked questions and their answers:
data.finisher: These FAQs provide a comprehensive overview for students looking to their placements. The T&P Cell is dedicated to facilitating a seamless student experience and ensuring that student find the best placements suited to their skills and talent.

faq.Question: I have a remote intern in a startup, I started it in June and it's supposed to continue till August, will I have to leave this before sitting for on campus placement drives?
faq.Answer: You cannot hold two offers together/you cannot do two internships together(virtual+in-Person). To be eligible for Internship Drive, you must be exclusively dedicated & available for the drive & for next Mid May to Mid July duration joining-officilly designated.

faq.Question: I wish to continue applying for interns in small companies/startups and research interns, these will be remote and finish before the time of the start of my Intern next summer, Can I do that?
faq.Answer:
You cannot hold two offers together/you cannot do two internships together(virtual+in-Person). To be eligible for Internship Drive, you must be exclusively dedicated & available for the drive & for next Mid May to Mid July duration joining-officilly designated. 
 Also I'm not sure how they are going to include this with regular classes in CV, as anything during the academic session needs NOC.

faq.Question: If I want to apply (when I haven't received any offer) to companies myself for Summer Internship, via asking members for referrals, sitting for open positions etc. (Off-Campus),  If I tell the CAMC, will I be barred from sitting in On-Campus Drives?
faq.Answer: You cannot hold two offers together/you cannot do two internships together(virtual+in-Person). To be eligible for Internship Drive, you must be exclusively dedicated & available for the drive & for next Mid May to Mid July duration joining-officilly designated.

faq.Question: Since I have 6 month industrial/on-site internship with proper NOC, what will happen to the resume verification in my case? I want to participate in placement drive after coming back to college.
faq.Answer:
In this case contact your managers, write a request email attach NOC-with reason to them, mark APO in CC. 
 Once approved by Placement Office any of the Manager can do this online and once the student is back on-campus the same can be verified before the commencement of the drive.

faq.Question: Do we need to inform Placement Office everytime we apply for an off campus internship?
faq.Answer: Yes. Mandatory before you get an interview/test call and after u get selected or rejected

faq.Question: Is one student is allowed to have two internships if there timings are different like one oncampus and one offcampus?
faq.Answer: You cannot hold two offers together/you cannot do two internships together(virtual+in-Person). To be eligible for Internship Drive, you must be exclusively dedicated & available for the drive & for next Mid May to Mid July duration joining-officilly designated.

faq.Question: When will the resume verification of 4th Years take place?
faq.Answer:
Just after the Internship Drive -May be 1st week od Sept, by that time you can update the CV with Internships done. 
 This will be done by managers for their departments under my supervision.

faq.Question: Can I remove Key Courses Taken Section from my Resume
faq.Answer: Yes, it's not mandatory but if you have taken some good courses online or somewhere it'll add a good value to your resume

faq.Question: What if the internship completion certificate is not available by the time CV verification happens? Will the offer letter work in that case?
faq.Answer: NO. Completion certificate /email is must to write in CV

faq.Question:
What we have to do if we want to change our CV after verification 
 ( like after a month or so, if we want to add something)
faq.Answer: NO. Completion certificate /email is must to write in CV

faq.Question: I am currently doing an internship which will be over on 4th August! So will receive the completion certificate after that. Can I use the offer letter during verification instead of the CoC?
faq.Answer: NO. Completion certificate /email is a must to write in CV. becuase we will be unsure of sucessful completion.

faq.Question: Can I add something if i had missed in my resume after verification is done?
faq.Answer: Answer not available

faq.Question: By which month will the first company arrive?
faq.Answer: Internship - Last week of July Placements- Decemeber (the process will start from October)

faq.Question: Is it true that the PPTs/first rounds of all companies will be held collectively during sept-oct and interviews will be held collectively during dec?
faq.Answer: Yes

faq.Question: Please explain the new placement procedure that we are to start from this year briefly.
faq.Answer: There is nothing new, go through the policies thoroughly, attend the induction T&P session of your department.For major concern ask your Managers & for minor concerns you can connect with CAMC team (coordinators).

faq.Question: If we have an on campus offer, can we not approach for any off campus opportunities?
faq.Answer: No U can't - Penalty will be imposed in case you leave an on campus offer and go for an off campus opportunity, which will be carried forward to next placement Drive

recruiterProcess.title: Company Invitations
recruiterProcess.content: The Career Advancement & Mentoring Centre , IIT Indore sends invitations to companies along with relevant information and Job Announcement Form (JAF). The recruiters also can send an email expressing their interest to participate in the campus recruitment program of IIT Indore on placementofficer@iiti.ac.in / apo@iiti.ac.in.

recruiterProcess.title: Job Announcement Form Submission
recruiterProcess.content: Companies interested in recruiting can fill the JAF for each profile they wish to hire for.

recruiterProcess.title: Company Registration
recruiterProcess.content: Once the filled JAF with all required details is received, companies are considered to be registered and will be contacted for further processes.

recruiterProcess.title: Pre-placement Talks
recruiterProcess.content: Companies interested in conducting a pre-placement talk can send a request along with the preferred date(s).

recruiterProcess.title: Job Announcements to Students
recruiterProcess.content: The Job Announcement Form of the company will be made available online to all the eligible students. Interested students may apply online to each of the job roles offered by the company within a specified period.

recruiterProcess.title: Student Shortlisting
recruiterProcess.content: The company can shortlist the students based on their shortlisting criteria like CV screening/assessment/GD.

recruiterProcess.title: Campus Interview Scheduling
recruiterProcess.content: Further, the CAMC office allots the dates for campus interviews considering factors like student preference, job profile, compensation, association with the institution, etc.

recruiterProcess.title: Final Selection List Submission
recruiterProcess.content: The company is required to submit the list of selected and waitlisted (if any) candidates to the CAMC office on the same day itself.

transportInfo.air: The nearest airport is Devi Ahilyabai Holkar Airport (IDR), located about 25 km from the IIT Indore campus. Taxis and pre-paid cabs are available from the airport to reach the institute.
transportInfo.train: Indore Junction (INDB) is the main railway station, approximately 20 km from the campus. You can take a taxi or use app-based cab services to reach IIT Indore from the station.
transportInfo.road: Indore has a well-connected bus network. The nearest bus stop to IIT Indore is Simrol, from where you can take a local auto or taxi to reach the campus. IIT Indore is located on Khandwa Road (NH 59A). If you're driving, use GPS navigation and follow the signs to Simrol. The campus is well-marked and easy to locate.
